ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) to 15% high-intensity (white) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region centered at the fluke hinge; high-intensity white pigmentation and scarring are concentrated at the distal tips and in linear streaks radiating from the medial trailing edge toward the lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, irregular V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 70 degrees, characterized by jagged edges rather than a smooth curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularities including multiple deep indentations and jagged peaks along the entire margin; significant tissue loss visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex trajectory from the hinge to the tips, heavily modified by significant geometric deviations and traumatic indentations along the trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups detected primarily on the extreme lateral tips (leading edges near the points).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing both lobes, with a high concentration of diagonal marks on the left lobe and horizontal streaks on the right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jagged trailing edge characterized by traumatic indentations and significant missing tissue segments, particularly adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-hatched 'X' shaped scarring pattern located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.
